beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier while a compact DQ-CTM thought process updates it through shared recurrent ticks.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: ThinkSR separates the dense image field from the compact recurrent computation that edits it. The encoder turns the low-resolution image into the carrier the rest of the method keeps using. Windowing partitions that carrier so the thought process can operate locally. The DQ-CTM ticks repeatedly with shared parameters, updating the carrier through the same thought stage. The decoder turns the updated dense field back into the super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR runs a dense carrier through compact recurrent thought
params.note: The recurrence belongs to the thought stage, not the full pipeline.

beats.intent: The carrier equation first makes a dense feature field from the low-resolution image, then partitions that field while preserving every token.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The equation defines the carrier before any recurrent thought step changes it. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into a dense feature field. The low-resolution image is the input that starts the carrier. The window partition operates on that dense field rather than discarding tokens.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded first, then partitioned into windows

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the comparison; at 1.129 million parameters, it is second largest among the five methods.
beats.claim: ×4 lightweight super-resolution, average over five benchmarks.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison puts DQ-CTM-SR among lightweight super-resolution baselines, but it is not the cheap end of this group. CATANet is the smallest at zero point five three five million parameters. RFDN is close behind at zero point five five zero million. IMDN uses zero point seven one five million. DQ-CTM-SR uses one point one two nine million, making it the second largest of the five. CARN is largest at one point five nine two million.
